001package com.streamConverter.command.impl;
002
003import com.streamConverter.command.AbstractStreamCommand;
004import java.io.BufferedReader;
005import java.io.IOException;
006import java.io.InputStream;
007import java.io.InputStreamReader;
008import java.io.OutputStream;
009import java.io.OutputStreamWriter;
010import java.io.Writer;
011import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
012import java.util.ArrayList;
013import java.util.Arrays;
014import java.util.List;
015
016/**
017 * CSV Filter Command Class
018 *
019 * <p>This class implements pure data extraction from CSV using column selectors. Unlike
020 * CsvNavigateCommand which applies transformations, CsvFilterCommand only extracts/filters columns
021 * based on specified column names or indices without any modifications.
022 *
023 * <p>Features: - Extract specific columns using column names or indices - Preserve exact data
024 * values from extracted columns - Memory-efficient streaming processing - Support for multiple
025 * column selection
026 */
027public class CsvFilterCommand extends AbstractStreamCommand {
028
029  private final List<String> columnSelectors;
030  private final boolean hasHeader;
031
032  /**
033   * Constructor for CSV filtering with single column selector.
034   *
035   * @param columnSelector the column name or index to extract (e.g., "name", "2")
036   * @param hasHeader whether the CSV has a header row
037   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if columnSelector is null or empty
038   */
039  public CsvFilterCommand(String columnSelector, boolean hasHeader) {
040    if (columnSelector == null || columnSelector.trim().isEmpty()) {
041      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Column selector cannot be null or empty");
042    }
043    this.columnSelectors = Arrays.asList(columnSelector.trim());
044    this.hasHeader = hasHeader;
045  }
046
047  /**
048   * Constructor for CSV filtering with multiple column selectors.
049   *
050   * @param columnSelectors list of column names or indices to extract
051   * @param hasHeader whether the CSV has a header row
052   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if columnSelectors is null or empty
053   */
054  public CsvFilterCommand(List<String> columnSelectors, boolean hasHeader) {
055    if (columnSelectors == null || columnSelectors.isEmpty()) {
056      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Column selectors cannot be null or empty");
057    }
058    this.columnSelectors = new ArrayList<>(columnSelectors);
059    this.hasHeader = hasHeader;
060  }
061
062  /**
063   * Constructor for CSV filtering with single column selector (assumes header exists).
064   *
065   * @param columnSelector the column name or index to extract
066   */
067  public CsvFilterCommand(String columnSelector) {
068    this(columnSelector, true);
069  }
070
071  /**
072   * Constructor for CSV filtering with multiple column selectors (assumes header exists).
073   *
074   * @param columnSelectors list of column names or indices to extract
075   */
076  public CsvFilterCommand(List<String> columnSelectors) {
077    this(columnSelectors, true);
078  }
079
080  @Override
081  protected String getCommandDetails() {
082    return String.format("CsvFilterCommand(columns=%s, hasHeader=%s)", columnSelectors, hasHeader);
083  }
084
085  @Override
086  protected void executeInternal(InputStream inputStream, OutputStream outputStream)
087      throws IOException {
088    try (BufferedReader reader =
089            new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(inputStream, StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
090        Writer writer = new OutputStreamWriter(outputStream, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
091
092      List<Integer> columnIndices = new ArrayList<>();
093      String[] headers = null;
094
095      // Read first line
096      String firstLine = reader.readLine();
097      if (firstLine == null) {
098        // Empty CSV
099        writer.flush();
100        return;
101      }
102
103      String[] firstRowFields = parseCsvLine(firstLine);
104
105      if (hasHeader) {
106        headers = firstRowFields;
107        // Map column selectors to indices
108        columnIndices = mapColumnSelectorsToIndices(columnSelectors, headers);
109
110        // Write filtered header
111        writeFilteredRow(writer, firstRowFields, columnIndices);
112        writer.write(System.lineSeparator());
113      } else {
114        // No header - column selectors must be numeric indices
115        columnIndices = parseNumericColumnSelectors(columnSelectors, firstRowFields.length);
116
117        // Write filtered first data row
118        writeFilteredRow(writer, firstRowFields, columnIndices);
119        writer.write(System.lineSeparator());
120      }
121
122      // Process remaining data rows
123      String line;
124      while ((line = reader.readLine()) != null) {
125        String[] fields = parseCsvLine(line);
126        writeFilteredRow(writer, fields, columnIndices);
127        writer.write(System.lineSeparator());
128      }
129
130      writer.flush();
131    }
132  }
133
134  /**
135   * Map column selectors to column indices
136   *
137   * @param selectors list of column names or indices
138   * @param headers array of header names
139   * @return list of column indices
140   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if column not found
141   */
142  private List<Integer> mapColumnSelectorsToIndices(List<String> selectors, String[] headers) {
143    List<Integer> indices = new ArrayList<>();
144
145    for (String selector : selectors) {
146      // Try as column name first
147      boolean found = false;
148      for (int i = 0; i < headers.length; i++) {
149        if (headers[i].equals(selector)) {
150          indices.add(i);
151          found = true;
152          break;
153        }
154      }
155
156      if (!found) {
157        // Try as numeric index
158        try {
159          int index = Integer.parseInt(selector);
160          if (index >= 0 && index < headers.length) {
161            indices.add(index);
162            found = true;
163          }
164        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
165          // Not a valid number
166        }
167      }
168
169      if (!found) {
170        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Column not found: " + selector);
171      }
172    }
173
174    return indices;
175  }
176
177  /**
178   * Parse numeric column selectors when no header exists
179   *
180   * @param selectors list of column indices as strings
181   * @param totalColumns total number of columns available
182   * @return list of column indices
183   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if index is invalid
184   */
185  private List<Integer> parseNumericColumnSelectors(List<String> selectors, int totalColumns) {
186    List<Integer> indices = new ArrayList<>();
187
188    for (String selector : selectors) {
189      try {
190        int index = Integer.parseInt(selector);
191        if (index < 0 || index >= totalColumns) {
192          throw new IllegalArgumentException("Column index out of range: " + selector);
193        }
194        indices.add(index);
195      } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
196        throw new IllegalArgumentException(
197            "Invalid column index (must be numeric when no header): " + selector);
198      }
199    }
200
201    return indices;
202  }
203
204  /**
205   * Parse a CSV line into fields (simple implementation)
206   *
207   * @param line CSV line
208   * @return array of field values
209   */
210  private String[] parseCsvLine(String line) {
211    // Simple CSV parsing - handles basic comma separation
212    // For production, consider using a proper CSV library
213    if (line == null || line.isEmpty()) {
214      return new String[0];
215    }
216
217    List<String> fields = new ArrayList<>();
218    StringBuilder current = new StringBuilder();
219    boolean inQuotes = false;
220
221    for (int i = 0; i < line.length(); i++) {
222      char c = line.charAt(i);
223
224      if (c == '"') {
225        inQuotes = !inQuotes;
226      } else if (c == ',' && !inQuotes) {
227        fields.add(current.toString().trim());
228        current.setLength(0);
229      } else {
230        current.append(c);
231      }
232    }
233
234    fields.add(current.toString().trim());
235    return fields.toArray(new String[0]);
236  }
237
238  /**
239   * Write filtered row with only selected columns
240   *
241   * @param writer output writer
242   * @param fields all field values
243   * @param columnIndices indices of columns to include
244   * @throws IOException if writing fails
245   */
246  private void writeFilteredRow(Writer writer, String[] fields, List<Integer> columnIndices)
247      throws IOException {
248    for (int i = 0; i < columnIndices.size(); i++) {
249      if (i > 0) {
250        writer.write(",");
251      }
252
253      int columnIndex = columnIndices.get(i);
254      if (columnIndex < fields.length) {
255        String field = fields[columnIndex];
256        // Quote field if it contains comma or quotes
257        if (field.contains(",") || field.contains("\"")) {
258          writer.write("\"" + field.replace("\"", "\"\"") + "\"");
259        } else {
260          writer.write(field);
261        }
262      } else {
263        // Column doesn't exist in this row - write empty field
264        writer.write("");
265      }
266    }
267  }
268}
